name: Boss theme
notes: The Alpha fight. Starts only when the Alpha wakes (the moment the 24th wild monster faints): the run theme stops under its roar and, 40 ticks later, this song begins. It plays until the run ends; victory, game over, RESTART and QUIT each switch to their own scene's song, so it is never heard anywhere else. A darker, faster cousin of the run theme: same E minor, same instruments and drum kit, but 176 BPM instead of 155, a sharper 25 % lead, a galloping octave bass, and the leading tone D# plus a menacing F for drama. A short suspense intro plays once (a pedal bass with a trembling harmony, then climbing 3-3-2 stabs and a snare roll), then the loop: the hook (the run theme's rising E minor arpeggio, darkened), its answer, the hook again and a peak; then a breakdown with heartbeat drums and a slowly creeping inner line, a rebuild, and a climbing diminished chord with a snare roll back into the hook. Kept as quiet as the other songs (melody at volume 3, harmony and drums 2, bass 1 with a half-height waveform) so every hit, miss and roar is heard over it.
